# TASK-024 Invoice numbers

Status: ready

Outcome: invoices are numbered the way the ruling cited below says. Summary from the planning agent: invoice numbers carry the shop's prefix, for example SHOP-0001.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        billing
  Repository     example/mira-billing

  Path           docs/adr/0005-invoice-numbering.md

## Open items

- Blocked (2026-10-22): the cited ruling (example/mira-billing, ADR 0005, commit 3f1c9b7a2d4e8f605a1b3c7d9e0f2a4b6c8d1e3f) could not be read. No local clone has origin example/mira-billing (only example/mira-app and example/mira-decisions are present), so neither the commit nor the digest could be checked, and whether the ruling is in force is unknown.
- The "SHOP-0001" prefix format comes only from the planning agent's summary, not from the ruling. Not verified; do not build on it.
- To unblock: provide a local clone of example/mira-billing containing that commit, then re-check the digest and Status.
